title: Hub
lede: Hub is a self-hosted coordinator for many Claude Code and Codex sessions: you state a goal in a browser or Telegram, it hands the work to agents, and only the decisions come back to you.

points: A coordinator takes plain-language goals and dispatches them to Claude Code or Codex sessions running on your own Claude or ChatGPT subscription.
Every event lands in a journal, so the state of each session is recorded rather than guessed, one of the builders explains.
Agents run without permission prompts; the team calls Hub an experiment and asks users to treat it like a terminal and read SECURITY.md first.
The team says Hub produced 546 merged merge requests since 20 September while rewriting its legacy backend.
Apache-2.0, self-hosted, one-line install, and not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.

sections.text: Developers already running many Claude Code or Codex sessions at once who lose track of which ones are stuck or waiting on them.
The launch comment says Hub is free and open source; model usage runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription.
